en.bdb: Creation of the wondrous Lord Vahiguru

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: trrai gun maiaa khel kar dhekhaaliaa|

en.bdb: The Lord has produced this world as the play of the three dimensional maya.
He has accomplished the feat of (the creation of) four life mines (egg, foetus, sweat, vegetation) and four speeches (pars, pasyanti, madhyama and vaikhar).
Creating from the five elements he bound them all in a divine law.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maeh siraj samhaaliaa|

en.bdb: He created and sustained the six seasons and the twelve months.
For day and night He lit the sun and the moon as lamps.
With one vibrational throb he expanded the whole creation and delighted it through his graceful glance.
